title: ID0469128-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2 / R3 313020197004] Intermittent communication between Sicharge-D and PLC
description: Reported behavior/issue: Intermittent communication between Siemens Sicharge-D and PLC – ELMS / Load Balance.

additional_info.subject: Intermittent communication between Siemens Sicharge-D and PLC – ELMS / Load Balance
additional_info.body:
Hello everyone,
We have identified a communication issue with the Siemens Sicharge-D charger,
SN: Y2 R4 313020197004
ID: 7PSil9.
At this site, we have a dynamic load control (Load Balance) project already implemented and fully operational. Together with Siemens Brazil, we carried out the ELMS activation, as well as the IP and port configuration, as shown in the attached image.
Initially, the VLAN/IP was configured as 10.20.37.1. We then changed it to 192.168.0.160, keeping port 400 unchanged. After this adjustment, communication between the charger and our PLC was successfully established. However, after a short period of time (approximately 10 minutes at most), the charger stops communicating with the PLC, resulting in a complete disconnection.
To restore communication, a hard reboot of the charger is required. Once rebooted, communication is reestablished, but the issue repeats again after a few minutes.
While on site, we also performed additional tests by replacing the PLC with a notebook acting as a client, establishing the connection directly. Even in this scenario, the same behavior was observed, with communication dropping after a short interval.
It is important to note that we already have six other sites with this same active load control functionality, using an equivalent configuration, and none of them have presented this type of instability so far.
Therefore, we kindly request your support to analyze this scenario, identify the possible root cause, and provide guidance on the necessary actions to stabilize the communication.
I look forward to your feedback.
Best regards,
Felipe Trajano
P&D - Engenharia
www.raizen.com​​​
